title: Karadi Gavi Betta
tagline: Bengaluru → Bidadi → Ramanagara → Karadi Gavi Betta. ~65 km, a granite rock face above a clear lake.
summary: Karadi Gavi Betta sits near Avverahalli in Ramanagara taluk, a few hundred metres from SRS (Revanasiddeshwara) Betta. A large granite rock face drops to a lake with unusually clear water. It makes an easy Sunday breakfast ride: highway to Bidadi and Ramanagara, then quieter village roads south-east into the boulder country around SRS hills. Visitors come for the lake viewpoint, picnics, birdwatching and camping.

segments.note: Out of the city along Mysuru Road to Bidadi. Leave early to beat traffic.
Highway run to Ramanagara with its granite hills alongside.
Narrower rural roads through boulder country to the SRS Betta area. The last stretch may be broken.

highlights: A sheer granite rock face rising beside a clear-water lake
Lake viewpoint for a quiet breakfast or picnic, with good birdwatching
SRS (Revanasiddeshwara) Betta next door: about 300 steps cut into a monolith, climbed barefoot
A short ride that leaves the rest of Sunday free

offroad.summary: Almost all tarmac. Only the final village approach may be rough or unpaved.
notes: Any road bike can do it. Take the last few hundred metres slowly.
Park on firm ground, as the lakeshore can be soft after rain.

timings: Leave Bengaluru by 6 am to reach for sunrise and breakfast
Allow 1–2 hrs at the lake, more if you also climb SRS Betta
cautions: Don't swim: the water is deep, there are no lifeguards, and drownings in lakes and quarry pits around Bengaluru are common
Stay back from the edge of the rock face, especially when it's wet
No shops at the viewpoint. Carry water and food, and take your trash back
SRS Betta is a temple hill and must be climbed barefoot. The rock gets very hot by late morning.
